 Pachuca 1 – 2 Cruz Azul Venegas 20' Fernández 13' Montaño 79' (P) FULL TIME Summary: Pachuca 1-2 Cruz Azul in Liga MX
 With a penalty goal from Montaño, "La Máquina" defeats Pachuca 2-1, securing the win and all 3 points in this Matchday 13 of Liga MX.
 Coverage by Juan Carlos Vera López Updated October 22, 2026, 1:15 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 1:15 AM ET 90' Oct 22 1:14 AM ET 29 minutes ago End of match
 The match ends with a final score of Pachuca 1–2 Cruz Azul. Both teams treated us to a great game in "La Bella Airosa," and in the end, the visitors secure an important victory and all 3 points in this Matchday 13 of Liga MX.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 Key moments
 1:14 AM ET 90' End of match 
 12:53 AM ET 84' Goal by Andrés Montaño · 1-2 
 12:00 AM ET 45' Halftime 
 11:32 PM ET 23' Goal by Francisco Venegas · 1-1 
 11:25 PM ET 18' Goal by Gabriel Fernández · 0-1 
 11:11 PM ET Kickoff 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 88' Oct 22 12:56 AM ET an hour ago We are in the final stretch of this great match; it remains to be seen how much stoppage time the referee will add to a game that is reaching a nail-biting conclusion. Both teams are making their final substitutions, and "La Máquina" is closing in on victory.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 84' Oct 22 12:53 AM ET an hour ago Goal for Cruz Azul! Montaño, from the penalty spot, gives "La Máquina" the lead with a superb strike that beats Moreno; the *Celestes* are now very close to securing all 3 points in what has been a truly thrilling match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 80' Oct 22 12:50 AM ET an hour ago We’ve reached the final 10 minutes of the match, and once again it’s an end-to-end affair; the *celestes* continue to look slightly the better side, edging closer to a goal that would give them the lead in this closing stretch of the game.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 76' Oct 22 12:45 AM ET an hour ago Pachuca has also made two substitutions, adjusting in an attempt to regain control of the midfield—an area they had lost due to the strong performance of Cruz Azul, who continue to press. Despite the scoreline, the fans keep cheering and applying pressure.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 72' Oct 22 12:39 AM ET an hour ago Pachuca continues to commit many fouls, and the yellow cards are starting to be shown; there is great intensity in this second half, and the *celestes* keep pressing, looking for a second goal that would put them ahead on the scoreboard.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 68' Oct 22 12:35 AM ET an hour ago Cruz Azul makes two substitutions with the aim of becoming much more attacking and finding the goal that would give them the lead; Luka Romero and Rogelio González have come onto the pitch—the visiting side has made its move.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 64' Oct 22 12:29 AM ET an hour ago Cramps are beginning to affect the match, a result of the rain that has fallen on the pitch at Estadio Hidalgo; goalkeeper Moreno is receiving attention for a possible muscle strain—we shall see if he can continue on the field of play.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 60' Oct 22 12:27 AM ET an hour ago The substitute players are getting up to warm up in preparation for potential substitutions, while the coaches are conferring with their assistants to plan tactical adjustments for this stage of the second half—there is a great deal of intensity in this match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 56' Oct 22 12:23 AM ET an hour ago Pachuca commits many fouls in its attempt to win back the ball; the team struggles defensively, unable to shake off the pressure from the visitors, who have started the second half in better form, great second time,
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 52' Oct 22 12:21 AM ET an hour ago La Máquina looks to create danger down the flanks through Campos, aiming to deliver crosses into the box that can find an unmarked forward; the *Celestes* have made a stronger start to this second half.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 48' Oct 22 12:19 AM ET an hour ago There are no changes for the second half; the same 22 players take the field for the conclusion of this highly exciting match. "La Máquina" starts with the ball, looking to regain the lead they lost, great start.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 45' Oct 22 12:00 AM ET 2 hours ago Halftime
 The first half ends with the score at 1-1 between Pachuca and Cruz Azul; it has been a great match with plenty of goal-scoring opportunities, though lacking in clinical finishing. We shall see what the second half has in store for us in this fantastic football match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 43' 11:49 PM ET 2 hours ago Entering the final stretch of the first half; we’ll see how much stoppage time the referee adds to this match, which is shaping up to be an exciting, back-and-forth affair—'La Máquina' currently holds possession.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 39' 11:45 PM ET 2 hours ago Final minutes of the first half; we are 6 minutes—plus stoppage time—away from the break in what has been a very exciting match. Let’s see which team can finish this first half the strongest, great close.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 35' 11:41 PM ET 2 hours ago We are approaching the final stretch of the first half, and the pace of the match has slowed down; the ball is being played much more in the midfield, and there are few dangerous attacks. The score remains a 1-1 draw.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 31' 11:37 PM ET 2 hours ago We’ve reached the 30-minute mark, and Cruz Azul is pressing once again, looking to regain the lead they lost; they are trying to push the ball forward to Fernández, but so far, they haven’t been effective.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 27' 11:35 PM ET 2 hours ago There are many fouls being committed that prevent the ball from moving smoothly; a heavy downpour is also starting, which will make things very difficult for this match and quickly affect the condition of the pitch—we shall see how the game unfolds.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 23' 11:32 PM ET 2 hours ago Goal for Pachuca! The equalizer comes following a lapse by the Cementeros' defense that leaves Venegas unmarked inside the box; he finishes well to level the score in this first half—a great response from the home side.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 22' 11:27 PM ET 2 hours ago The team looks energized following the opening goal, continuing to press and attack in search of extending their lead; Pachuca attempts to respond but lacks clarity in the final third—the match is being played at a great pace.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 18' 11:25 PM ET 2 hours ago Goal for Cruz Azul! A superb long pass sets up Toro Fernández, who fires a precise cross-shot to give "La Máquina" the lead. They’ve capitalized on a dangerous attacking opportunity—now let’s see how Pachuca responds.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 14' 11:22 PM ET 2 hours ago Cruz Azul has struggled to create any real threat; they are now forced to defend and try to relieve the pressure applied by the Tuzos. It’s been a high-intensity match, yet still goalless—the *Cementeros* have managed to survive the first half.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10' 11:18 PM ET 2 hours ago It’s an end-to-end match with chances at both ends, and both teams have already managed to avoid conceding an opening goal; the game has a great tempo in this first half, which has gotten off to an exciting start.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6' 11:14 PM ET 2 hours ago There’s a lot of ball possession in this phase of the match; it remains to be seen whether the team decides to try their luck with shots from outside the box and look to create their first dangerous attacking opportunities. Meanwhile, the coaches are beginning to issue instructions.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 3' 11:12 PM ET 3 hours ago There is a fierce battle for the ball in these opening minutes, and Cruz Azul is looking to push forward by playing long balls; the fans keep cheering, the match has a great tempo, and Pachuca is trying to win back possession.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 11:11 PM ET 3 hours ago Kickoff
 The first half between Pachuca and Cruz Azul is underway; this big match has kicked off, and "La Máquina" is immediately looking to apply pressure and create scoring threats—a promising start to the match in the "Bella Airosa."
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:55 PM ET 3 hours ago Follow Pachuca vs Cruz Azul Live Score with VAVEL!
 We will soon share the starting lineups for the live match between Pachuca and Cruz Azul, along with the latest updates coming from Estadio Hidalgo. Both teams will be looking to take a significant step forward in this Matchday 13 of Liga MX.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:48 PM ET 3 hours ago Hidalgo Stadium
 This is the home of Pachuca and one of the most significant stadiums in Liga MX. With a capacity of 25,000 spectators, it was inaugurated on February 14, 1993. It will host the match between Pachuca and Cruz Azul—a game expected to draw a full-capacity crowd, as it is one of the best matchups of the weekend. It is, without a doubt, a great stadium for a great football match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:47 PM ET 3 hours ago All ready
 Everything is set for the start of the match; the players are ready and awaiting the signal to take the field at Estadio Hidalgo, where the ball will soon be in play for what promises to be a very exciting match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:29 PM ET 3 hours ago End of warmup
 The players from Pachuca and Cruz Azul have finished their warm-ups and are heading back to their dressing rooms to receive final instructions from their coaches before returning to the pitch for the start of the first 45 minutes; we are just moments away from the beginning of this big match.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:28 PM ET 3 hours ago Cruz Azul lineup
 Here is the lineup for the visitors as they take on Pachuca in a highly anticipated match; they will be looking to secure all 3 points at Estadio Hidalgo. A strong lineup from the visiting side, great lineup:
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:27 PM ET 3 hours ago Pachuca lineup
 This is the Pachuca lineup as they look to secure a win and all 3 points. Playing at home, they will be going for the victory in a match that promises to be the best of this 13th round of Mexican football—a great lineup:
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:13 PM ET 4 hours ago How to watch Pachuca vs Cruz Azul Live Stream on TV and Online?
 The Pachuca vs. Cruz Azul match will not be broadcast on television.
 If you want to watch the Pachuca vs. Cruz Azul match, it will be available via streaming on the Fox One app.
 If you want to watch the Pachuca vs. Cruz Azul match online, VAVEL is your best option.
 Updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:08 PM ET 4 hours ago All ready warmup
 The players from Pachuca and Cruz Azul are now taking the field, beginning their pre-match preparations for this major football encounter with 3 points on the line. We will soon know the starting lineups for what promises to be a compelling match at Estadio Hidalgo.
